name: Mihoshi Kanata
source:
"Unlike my [url=/c138880]sister[/url], may a small, adorable, and transcendental beautiful girl appear as my girlfriend!!"

The protagonist of the story. A good-looking all-rounder who is good at both academics and sports. He is attentive, and seems to be good at dealing with women, might be because he has been taking care of his footloose sister. Perhaps due to this, people around him think he is a [i]siscon[/i]. Basically, he is a kind person who never refuses a request from anyone, there are times when he helps others more than necessary as well. He likes to visit the shrine everyday.
